nom: HERBIVORE PINK CLOUD Rosewater + Tremella Creamy Jelly Cleanser

segments.oily: Not enough reviewers describe oily skin specifically to draw conclusions.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including several describing it as chronically or winter-dry, report the cleanser removes makeup and cleans without leaving a tight or stripped feeling, several calling it their best cleanser for dry skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (including sensitive-combination) skin report it balances their skin, hydrates, and stops maskne or irritation without stripping.
segments.sensitive: The largest single group of reviewers describes sensitive skin and reports the cleanser as gentle, non-drying, non-irritating and, for several, the first cleanser that doesn't cause itching, burning or redness; one still developed a mild rash.
segments.normal: The few reviewers with normal skin report it keeps their skin balanced and removes makeup and excess oil without irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as older or mature report it keeps dry, aging skin supple and hydrated and is credited with visibly clearer, softer skin over time.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report softer, clearer-looking skin over time and better hydration, though one is skeptical that the product actually slows aging itself.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including those with dry and dehydrated-normal skin, report the cleanser hydrates or at least does not dry out the skin, with repeated mentions of no tight or taut feeling after washing.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced redness and no inflammation after cleansing, including one whose maskne-related redness evened out; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers recovering from retinoid or benzoyl-peroxide-induced irritation report the cleanser helped their skin recover from dryness and irritation without further compromising it.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports fewer breakouts and improved skin control over time; no other reviewer discusses spots specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report no new breakouts and some improvement, but one reviewer notes ongoing struggles with acne despite finding the product otherwise effective.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers mention it removes excess oil from the gym or cooking without over-drying, but oiliness itself is rarely discussed as an ongoing concern.

extraits.texte: I have very sensitive skin so most cleansers dry it out unfortunately. This one is very gentle, like the Curology cleanser and doesn't dry out my skin too bad. I repurchased once the first one ran out and I'm pretty happy. I also love that it comes in glass packaging and no longer has a plastic sticker on the bottle. However I'm giving the product 4 stars because I bought it for the glass bottle originally and I just discovered that the paper box it comes in is not recyclable because it has a plastic film on it to keep the box matte. I u detest and that it may be that way because the brand wants to give people a light and fluffy feel, but I think the product speaks for itself and there could be a soft box that is not covered in a plastic film that the majority of recycling centers don't have the equipment to be able to process. I'm seeing good progress and I like this cleanser a lot so I hope that is something that Herbivore can look into and consider changing. Otherwise I might not repurchase..

I'm an older gal, and my skin is going crazy from hormonal. But mostly my skin is tend to get dryer as I get older. I have tried so many facial cleanser from natural to clinical, but nothing.. nothing can come close to Pink Cloud! I love that it's actually clean my skin from sunscreen - I don't wear makeups, and it's also doesn't dry out my skin after wash. Doesn't cause any acnes or comedos. Please do not discontinued this EVER!

This stuff is magic. I've been struggling to find a skincare that works for me ever since Arbonne discontinued the AgeWell line. I have very dry and sensitive skin and have tried so many duds (including the trending tallow moisturizer which did not work for me so that's why I know my skin is a herbivore lol). I stumbled across this brand when I saw their products were breastfeeding safe but still had resurfacing power. My line up is the Pink Cloud Cleanser, Bakuchiol, Pink Cloud Moisturizer, and Orchid Oil for day and Emerald Oil at night. Got my mom hooked on it as well. SO GOOD

This is literally my holy grail! I started using this cleanser at the beginning of covid when maskne hit hard. I've tried many different cleansers before and since just to see what's out there, and everything else seems to dry out and irritate my sensitive combination skin. Not this one, though! I use this cleanser morning and night, and it leaves my skin feeling so soft and never stripped, even when I use retinoids. The redness in my skin is evened out and the maskne is gone! Please never stop making this!

extraits.titre: Non irritating and gets all the makeup off
extraits.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin and after going back and forth a few times with other brands, this is now my holy grail cleanser. It gets all my makeup off without making my skin red or inflamed. It also doesn't give my skin that 'tight' feeling which I learned is actually bad! I wish it was less pricy, but I'm willing to pay for it anyway so joke's on me I guess.

Love this cleanser!!!! It replenishes my dehydrated, sensitive, and acne-prone skin. My skin has recovered from retinoid and benzyl peroxide induced dryness and irritation. It has a nice rose fragrance and I love the glass bottle design. Definitely recommend this cleanser!!!

This a really good jelly cleanser. It does its job and after cleansing skin does not feel tight and dry. I do double cleansing so I cannot say how it will be if I jut this cleanser alone. I gave 4 star because , I was getting mild rash on my face and still think Cetaphil cleanser is superior in qality this cleanser
